秦夙转头看向椅子附带的监测屏幕。

【精神污染程度：74%。】

怎么还上涨了呢？她不是已经用小触手在探索他了吗？

“这就是你的目的？折磨我？让我对你认输，乞求你的宽恕？”魏知弦又哑声一笑，“哈……那你还真是，十分熟练。”

病态两个字很难跟魏知弦这种人扯上。

秦夙脑海还是飘过几个字，他该不是快被她逼疯了？

“我……还是第一次被强迫……”魏知弦紧咬牙关，颌角都绷出了锋利的轮廓，“成功疏导的前提是，双方互相信任，全然接纳彼此……你……跟着谢尘无，真是学到了……很不错的小花招……”

他到底脑补了啥啊？

谢尘无哪会教她那种骚了哄的花招，这不都是……误打误撞的嘛！

大力出奇迹了属于是！

秦夙看到屏幕上污染程度又往上升了几个点，已经到79%了！

“停下来！”魏知弦扭动身体挣扎起来，“秦夙，你得先平静下来，否则……嗯……”

【精神污染程度：83%。】

！！！

秦夙吓的赶紧收回手，拉断了精神力触手！

断端在空气中荡了一下，随即消散成红雾。

魏知弦又一声闷哼，数值跟着又跳了一下，变成85%了！

秦夙后背瞬间浮出一片冷汗，惊慌之下想离开治疗椅。

魏知弦的黑豹尾巴却用又急又重的力道，卷上她的腰身，迫使她再度扑回他的怀抱！

分明是野兽的本能，可魏知弦的声音却软的像在哀求，“别跑……你闯的祸……你得负责到底。”

每一个字都拖出湿润的尾音，声音哑得几乎碎掉，“姐姐……别怕……呼……试着，给我一点……向导素……那会很有用……能控制好我……”

【精神污染程度：89%。】

向导素有用。

可秦夙后腰深处埋藏的腺体还在发育中，她根本不知道自己现在就能放向导素！

“我该怎么做？”她揪住魏知弦的衣领，“你快点教我啊！”

“呵……”他居然又在笑，“实施惩罚的人，却又想起来……向受罚的人……求助了？”

秦夙真不知道他在嘀咕什么，是不是还把他给爽到了？

Qin Su turned his head and looked at the monitoring screen attached to the chair.

[Mental pollution level: 74%.】

Why is it still rising?Wasn't she already exploring him with her little tentacles?

"Is this your purpose? To torture me? To make me admit defeat to you and beg for your forgiveness?" Wei Zhixian laughed hoarsely again, "Ha... Then you are really, very skilled."

The word "morbid" is difficult to associate with a person like Wei Zhixian.

A few words still floated through Qin Su's mind. Was he about to be driven crazy by her?

"I... was forced for the first time..." Wei Zhixian gritted his teeth, and the corners of his jaw became sharp. "The prerequisite for successful communication is that both parties trust each other and fully accept each other... You... followed Xie Chenwu, and you really learned... a very good little trick..."

What on earth was he thinking about?

Xie Chenwu never taught her that coquettish trick. Wasn't it all... a mistake?

It’s true that great efforts can produce miracles!

Qin Su saw that the pollution level on the screen had increased a few points, reaching 79%!

"Stop!" Wei Zhixian twisted his body and struggled, "Qin Su, you have to calm down first, otherwise... well..."

[Mental pollution level: 83%.】

!!!

Qin Su was so frightened that he quickly retracted his hand and broke off the mental tentacle!

The broken end swayed in the air for a moment, and then dissipated into red mist.

Wei Zhixian groaned again, and the value jumped again, reaching 85%!

A cold sweat broke out on Qin Su's back, and he wanted to leave the treatment chair in panic.

However, Wei Zhixian's black panther tail wrapped around her waist with urgent and heavy force, forcing her to jump back into his arms again!

It was clearly the instinct of a beast, but Wei Zhixian's voice was as soft as pleading, "Don't run away... you've caused trouble... you have to take responsibility to the end."

Every word has a moist ending, and the voice is so hoarse that it almost breaks, "Sister... don't be afraid... Huh... try, give me a little bit... of the wizard... that will be very useful... you can control me..."

[Level of mental pollution: 89%.】

Guides are useful.

But the glands buried deep in Qin Su's lower back are still developing, and she has no idea that she can release guide elements now!

"What should I do?" She grabbed Wei Zhixian's collar, "Hurry up and teach me!"

"Haha..." He actually smiled again, "The person who carried out the punishment thought of... asking the person who was punished... for help?"

Qin Suzhen didn't know what he was mumbling. Did it make him happy?
